claim_one_line: THE VANISHING IS NOT FORMAL, NOW EXHIBITED -- AND THE FALSIFIER DOES NOT FIRE. Scanning one-cusped census manifolds with honest SL2(F_p) representations twisted by cusp-trivial characters turns up, on the CHIRAL one-cusped m010 (H_1 = Z/6 + Z, H_1/<peripheral> = Z/6), sectors with Sym^3 (x) chi where a_0 = a_0* = 0, t_0 = t_0* = 1, r_1 = 0 or 2, and I = +-1. Checked exhaustively with independently written self-contained code: relators evaluate to +I so odd Sym^3 is valid and this is NOT the -I trap that produced B1330's false positive; mu and lam commute and are genuinely unipotent so the cusp sits in a one-parameter unipotent group; all four identities hold; a_0 = a_0* and t_0 = t_0* so the sector is IN DOMAIN D with I = t_0 - r_1 as D requires; and no theorem forbids it, T2 needing M closed, T3 needing V self-dual, T4 rank one, T5 t_0 = 0. It is not a single-prime accident: the cusp-trivial character group is Z/6 so such characters exist only for p = 1 mod 6, and of the primes scanned exactly those (7 and 13) admit them and exactly those show the phenomenon, p = 5 and p = 11 having no qualifying representation at all. BUT IT DOES NOT SURVIVE TO CHARACTERISTIC ZERO. The parabolic SL2(C) character variety of a one-cusped manifold is finite, so most mod-p reps have no characteristic-zero counterpart, and the one that matters is rho_geo: computed at 60 digits, m010's geometric holonomy has relator -> +I but tr(mu) = tr(lam) = -2, NOT +2, so rho_geo(mu) is minus a unipotent, Sym^odd of it has every eigenvalue -1, t_0 = 0 and I = 0 by T5 -- the mod-p hits at Sym^3 live on the trace-+2 component, which rho_geo is not in. With the valid even germs Sym^2 and Sym^4 and every cusp-trivial character, characteristic zero gives a_0 = 0, a_1 = 1, t_0 = 1, r_1 = 1 and I = 0 in all ten sectors, with singular-value gaps of 1e45 to 1e50 so the numerical ranks are not close calls. SO FALSIFIER 6 DOES NOT FIRE -- m010 is not a cover of the object, the reps are not the geometric holonomy, and the hits die in characteristic zero -- and the programme's vanishing is untouched. WHAT IS ESTABLISHED is the structural half: the index identities and the domain conditions DO NOT IMPLY I = 0, since over F_7 and F_13 all of them hold while I = +-1. So no proof of the vanishing can be assembled from them alone; any proof must use something specific to characteristic zero or to the geometric component. That closes off a whole class of attempted proofs and explains why formal manipulation of B1297's four identities has never produced one -- there is nothing there to find. METHODOLOGICAL DEBT recorded: mod-p scanning over ARBITRARY SL2(F_p) representations can produce in-domain non-zero indices that do not exist in characteristic zero, so earlier scans using mod-p arithmetic on non-geometric representations inherit this caveat; a peripheral trace of -2 kills every odd germ by T5 on any manifold and is worth checking before spending a scan; and domain membership is necessary but not sufficient, since a random representation can satisfy the cusp condition while lying on a component carrying no geometric point.
